database.stem: All employees are reminded that there is much satisfaction to be gained from - ------ the community in some voluntary capacity.
database.raw_text:
All employees are reminded that there is much satisfaction to be gained from -
------ the community in some voluntary capacity.
(A) serving
(B) deserving
(C) reserving
(D) preserving
database.explanation:
横线处需要填入被in some voluntary capacity修饰、以the
community为宾语的动词，符合句意的是 (A) serving。
